text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ――These blueprints, the math is dead serious. Talk about overdoing it for a theme park.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right?! I had a feeling we could all have fun and take a breather here♪

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Once we get off this ride, which one next!?
Special perks mean barely any Guests around, let's conquer 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kuku――The waltz of life, or the promenade of Deimos... quite the conundrum.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――We're next.
The line――moved forward.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(Clear blue skies, a brand new amusement park, and wonderful friends!
――Yes, looks like we'll be making another lovely memory today♪)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet & Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
――Hmph... I have grasped it.
――Eureka! I got it!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet & Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ――The exit is this way!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You two, that one's a dummy, you know?
The real one is... over there♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow...! I got all of them wrong!
Kris, how did you manage to get every single one right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing――there's a trick to it.
First...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at this! The photo from the penalty game!
Shakur's face――wait, NO! Don't delete it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Shall we take the long way back?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Today was... fun.
So much so――that I feel reluctant to see it end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
We are――the same.
Therefore――you must feel it too.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
――...Say, do you remember?
Back when Kris and I had only just met...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ――When you talk about balancing everyday life with our sworn "mission", it might sound daunting, but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really, it's not like that at all, you know?
So please don't worry yourself over it so much!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah——understood.
...I am——the same——as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I too——have a "mission."
The "mission" is——the most important thing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Therefore——it is not tough.
Everything... is precious——to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Let us both do our best for our respective missions."
...I was so glad when you said that to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... As expected,
you and I are quite alike, Kris.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Not just our circumstances, but what we cherish,
how we protect them, and our priorities.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: In a way——it makes us feel like comrades, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...So, with that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kris, aren't you starving?
Come on! We ran around and played so much, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right.
Let's——stop by somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm!
Then let's go invite everyone else too~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the evening, at a park I visited for a change of pace,
I spotted Fine Motion and the others.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu~♪
Eating together makes it taste so much better, right, Kris!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ——Yeah.
